keyFindings.description: Lines 145-147, the new recovery hint, also printed by the required lint job and by pull_request-event runs. (1) 'Editing a review starts a new run by itself' is true only for the pull_request_review pr-title. When lint or the pull_request pr-title flagged the review (any push after it), an edit leaves those checks red with nothing re-running them. (2) 'the failed run' does not say which run. A re-run replays the frozen title and body of its payload (docs/solutions/legion/the-private-names-check-reads-each-events-frozen-body-...-LEGION-781.md). So a re-run of an older failed run gets the highest check-run id and can turn pr-title green over a newer run that failed on the body. Fix: one instruction for every kind: re-run the newest failed run of each check that reported it on the current head (lint, and pr-title once per event); never an older run.

Line 148 adds 'then re-run the failed run', which has the same gap. The edit must match the corrected hint. Also, the PR body's Outcome line says 'at most two PR Title runs per event' and 'never leaves a cancelled pr-title on the head'. Each trigger still starts a run (tester's #2261 has three runs for one event), and superseded cancelled check runs stay on the commit. The true claims are 'at most one running and one pending per event at a time' and 'the pr-title that stands for each event is never a cancelled run'.
